name: Civil-service exam interest areas
description: Maintainable mapping of NYC civil-service exam titles into subscribable interest areas. Rules live here (data, not code). First matching title_rule wins; exam_overrides and title_code_overrides take precedence. Areas marked subscribable are eligible for a future alerts surface — that surface is a separate gated product card.

areas.label: Public safety
areas.description: Police, fire, correction, traffic enforcement, and related protective titles.

areas.label: Health and care
areas.description: Clinical, public-health, therapy, and care titles.

areas.label: Engineering and construction
areas.description: Engineering, architecture, inspection, and construction titles.

areas.label: Technology and science
areas.description: IT, laboratory, research, and technical science titles.

areas.label: Community and social services
areas.description: Casework, housing, youth, and community program titles.

areas.label: Administration and finance
areas.description: Clerical, finance, procurement, and administrative titles.

areas.label: Trades and operations
areas.description: Skilled trades, facilities, fleet, and field operations titles.

areas.label: Other City work
areas.description: Titles that do not yet match a named interest series. Prefer adding a title_rule or exam_override over inventing a new area casually.
